title: Software Update

@title.description: The title of the update window.

@menuItem.description: The menu item that checks for updates.

upToDateMessage: {app} {version} is currently the newest version available.

@upToDateMessage.description: {app} is the app's name, {version} its version.

unavailableMessage: {app} cannot update itself where it is installed. If a package manager installed it, update it there.

@unavailableMessage.description: The app cannot write where it is installed; {app} is its name.

developmentBuild: Development builds do not update themselves.

@developmentBuild.description: Why a development build does not update.

checkError: An error occurred while checking for updates. Please try again later.
installError: An error occurred while installing the update. Please try again later.
available: A new version of {app} is available!
availableMessage: {app} {version} is now available—you have {current}. Would you like to install it now?

@availableMessage.description: {app} is the app's name, {version} the new version, {current} the running one.

automaticDownloads: Automatically download and install updates in the future

@progress.description: The size downloaded and the whole size, each a megabytes message.

@megabytes.description: A size in decimal megabytes, with one fraction digit in the locale.

readyMessage: {app} {version} is installed and starts the next time you open {app}. Relaunch now to start using it.

@readyMessage.description: {app} is the app's name, {version} the new version.
